Method of Attack: Abuse of Accessibility Services permissions for notification interception to steal one-time codes
Automated Transfer System (ATS) framework enabling automatic credential theft, account balance checks, banking transactions, and fund transfers
Logging content of third-party authentication apps to bypass MFA
Cookies stealing from Android CookieManager via browser window with JavaScript interface to hijack web sessions

Banks including Chase, Citibank, American Express, ING, HSBC, Deutsche Bank, Wells Fargo, Amex, Citi, BNP, UniCredit, National Bank of Canada, BBVA, Santander, Caixa
13 cryptocurrency wallets including Binance, BitPay, KuCoin, Gemini, Coinbase
Attack Vector: Google Play store via Zombinder platform posing as currency converter app
Installation of malicious payload switching to Play Protect icon after install
Indicators of Compromise: Distribution via Zombinder platform on Google Play store
Use of JSON scripts for ATS execution
Malicious apps posing as currency converter with Play Protect icon
